asks.text: The art's rarity names don't match the game's. The art goes 07 Ascendant, 08 Transcendent, 09 Exalted. The game goes 7 Ancient, 8 Exalted, 9 Transcendent. I matched Transcendent and Exalted by name, and didn't use the Ascendant art yet. Realm 1 only has Common, Uncommon and…

The Party cards are taller and thinner than the new backgrounds. To keep every ornament, each card shows the whole picture with a thin dark band above and below it. Is that OK? The other options are to trim a little off the left and right sides so the picture fills the card…

The old cards had a soft glow and faint line pattern in the companion's habitat colour (green for Wildgrowth, orange for Beasts and so on). These were removed so the new background is the only decoration. Suggestion: leave them out.

items.title: Replace Tome-tier UI with one permanent numeric Portal progression
items.quote: LOREBOUND — Summoning System UI Refactor. Replace Tome-tier presentation with one permanent Portal progression. This request supersedes earlier Tome-tier UI direction. one permanent Summoning Portal / Rift ... one portal level progression ... Level 1, Level 2, Level 3 ... no Tome I / II / III / IV / V presentation ... no “Library > Tome III” style labeling. This request is primarily a UI / presentation refactor ... preserve current real functionality where possible ... all values displayed are real, live game values.

asks.text: Saves still on the old Gold summons (before the Lore Shard economy) now also pay the Gold price of the highest Tome, because price goes with the level. Players on Lore Shards still pay 1 Shard. Suggestion: keep it. Every live save should already be on Lore Shards, and the old…

When a summon opens, the reveal still shows the old Tome book picture for your Rift level. Suggestion: show the teal Rift picture you already approved there instead, so no Tome books are left. I didn't change it because it's approved art.
The game says "Rift", for example "Upgrade Rift" and "RIFT UPGRADES". Your request allows "Rift" or "Portal", so I kept "Rift" everywhere. Suggestion: keep "Rift". Say if you'd rather have "Portal".
The one-time save update popup still says "Your companions, Tomes and everything else stay as they are". Suggestion: change "Tomes" to "Rift level" there too.
It clashes with another change in progress, in grand-archive.js, so it isn't on the test site yet.
